media.title: Willi Domgraf-Fassbaender as Figaro — Ross Verlag postcard, c. 1928
media.altText: Photographic postcard portrait of the baritone Willi Domgraf-Fassbaender in costume as Figaro.
media.publicCaption: Willi Domgraf-Fassbaender as Figaro in Rossini’s Il barbiere di Siviglia, on a signed Ross Verlag artist postcard of about 1928. He took the lead in Ich will Dich Liebe lehren, singing Tränen in der Geige and Schön ist das ganze Leben.
media.publicCreditLine: Photographer unidentified; signed artist postcard, Ross Verlag, c. 1928; private collection, via Wikimedia Commons.
media.rightsNote: Public domain. The Wikimedia Commons file records the postcard as published more than seventy years ago without a public claim of authorship, which places an anonymous work out of copyright in the European Union, and as published before 1 January 1931, which places it out of copyright in the United States. The photographer is not named on the card.
